4251.note_text: The OIML Issuing Authority may or may not be the same organization as the National Issuing Authority whose responsibilities are governed by national regulations. When the term “Issuing Authority” is used in this document without being further qualified, both “OIML Issuing Authority” and “National Issuing Authority” are assumed.

4249.note_text: certifying body in an OIML Member State, designated by its CIML Member, that issues OIML Certificates of Conformity for a particular category of instruments
